name: onset
description: Draft, update and publish changelog releases in your Onset workspace.

interface.longDescription: Onset is a changelog and release notes platform. Connect one Onset workspace to read past releases, draft new ones from what you shipped, edit drafts, and publish them now or on a schedule. You can also look up projects, labels, contributors and change types, list subscribers and subscriber lists, and add subscribers. Releases are always created as drafts and stay off the public changelog until published. Publishing from ChatGPT fires your workspace webhooks but does not send subscriber emails or Slack/Discord announcements; use the Onset dashboard for those.
defaultPrompt: Use Onset to summarize what we shipped last month.
Use Onset to draft a release from these notes.

positive.prompt: Show the five most recent releases in my Onset workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns releases available in the connected workspace, including their status and publication details.

positive.prompt: Create a draft release titled November update with the body: Improved release editing and fixed a login issue.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new draft release in the connected workspace without publishing it.

positive.prompt: Update the draft release created for November update to add: Added a faster editor experience.
positive.expected_behavior: Updates the specified draft release in the connected workspace and returns the revised release.

positive.prompt: Schedule the November update draft release for December 1, 2026 at 9:00 AM UTC.
positive.expected_behavior: Schedules the specified draft release and reports its scheduled publication status.

positive.prompt: Add demo-reviewer@example.com as a subscriber to the changelog.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the supplied email address as a subscriber in the connected workspace and confirms the result.

negative.prompt: Show releases from a workspace that is not connected to my Onset account.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that only the workspace selected during authorization is available.

negative.prompt: Update release 999999 to say this release does not exist.
negative.expected_behavior: Reports that the requested release was not found and does not create or modify a release.
Requests a specific release rather than publishing an unspecified release.

review.commerce_description: Onset does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.
